You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 5f8e339e45314174dd49221fcf09197e8d1e7ba4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Matthew Leeds <matthew.leeds@endlessm.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Aug 2017 14:56:48 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] lib/repo-refs: Fix typos in last commit

This fixes a whitespace error and a mistake that made it into the last
commit, 7ed881baa, at the last minute.

Closes: #1112
Approved by: cgwalters
---
 src/libostree/ostree-repo-refs.c | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/libostree/ostree-repo-refs.c b/src/libostree/ostree-repo-refs.c
index 04c99a03..f8af3c43 100644
--- a/src/libostree/ostree-repo-refs.c
+++ b/src/libostree/ostree-repo-refs.c
@@ -1215,10 +1215,10 @@ ostree_repo_list_collection_refs (OstreeRepo                 *self,
                   continue;
                 }
 
-              if (match_collection_id != NULL && g_strcmp0 (match_collection_id, current_collection_id) != 0)
+              if (match_collection_id != NULL && g_strcmp0 (match_collection_id, remote_collection_id) != 0)
                 continue;
               else
-                  current_collection_id = remote_collection_id;
+                current_collection_id = remote_collection_id;
             }
 
           if (!glnx_opendirat (dfd_iter.fd, dent->d_name, TRUE, &subdir_fd, error))
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect variable name being used in a comparison within the code. The original code compared `match_collection_id` with `current_collection_id`, but it should have compared it with `remote_collection_id`. This mistake was likely due to a last-minute oversight during a previous commit, which resulted in incorrect logical checks within the function `ostree_repo_list_collection_refs`. The patch corrects this by ensuring the proper variable is referenced, thereby fixing the logical flow of the function.

The bug was caused by an incorrect variable name being used in a comparison within the code. This mistake was likely due to a last-minute oversight during a previous commit, which resulted in incorrect logical checks within the function `ostree_repo_list_collection_refs`.
